Ilse, level 28 Priester | combat engine 0.10.0

=== Healing ===
How to heal a given amount per second for the least mana. The levels are shares of the most you can heal.
With consumables: Manatrank, Triagetee, Geringes Klerikerelixier, Schwaches Manaöl, Rolle der Intelligenz II, Elixier der geringen Intelligenz, Geringes Magierblutelixier, Elixier der geringen Willenskraft, Rolle der Willenskraft II (+51.8 HPS).

Light damage: 50.9 HPS  (One target needs 51 healing per second: 25% of the most you can heal.)
  The mana lasts: 10.4 mana per second against 24.0 regenerated. You cast 38% of the time. 11% of the time is outside the five-second rule and regenerates in full.
  1. Erneuerung (Rang 1): keep it on the target  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 14.9 HPS]
  2. Geringes Heilen (Rang 3): the default heal, with pauses in between  [6.7/min, 28% of the time, 36.0 HPS]

Tank healing: 101.7 HPS  (One target needs 102 healing per second: 50% of the most you can heal.)
  The mana lasts: 22.3 mana per second against 22.8 regenerated. You cast 78% of the time.
  1. Erneuerung (Rang 1): keep it on the target  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 14.9 HPS]
  2. Geringes Heilen (Rang 3): the default heal, with pauses in between  [16.3/min, 68% of the time, 86.8 HPS]

Heavy damage: 152.6 HPS  (One target needs 153 healing per second: 75% of the most you can heal.)
  The mana lasts 2:14 min: 41.8 mana per second against 22.8 regenerated.
  1. Erneuerung (Rang 1): keep it on the target  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 14.9 HPS]
  2. Geringes Heilen (Rang 3): the default heal  [13.6/min, 57% of the time, 72.5 HPS]
  3. Heilen (Rang 2): in between, when the default heal is too slow  [6.7/min, 33% of the time, 65.2 HPS]
  4. Dunkles Opfer (Rang 1): 1x before the mana is gone: 565 mana for 440 health, which you heal back  [0.5/min, 0% of the time]

Everything you have: 203.5 HPS  (The most you can heal on one target: 203 healing per second, whatever it costs.)
  The mana lasts 42 s: 82.0 mana per second against 22.8 regenerated.
  1. Erneuerung (Rang 3): keep it on the target  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 22.3 HPS]
  2. Blitzheilung (Rang 1): the default heal  [36.0/min, 90% of the time, 181.1 HPS]
  3. Dunkles Opfer (Rang 1): 1x before the mana is gone: 565 mana for 440 health, which you heal back  [1.4/min, 0% of the time]

Group damage: 106.2 HPS  (5 targets need 106 healing per second together: 50% of the most you can heal there.)
  The mana lasts: 17.4 mana per second against 22.8 regenerated. You cast 75% of the time.
  1. Erneuerung (Rang 1): keep it on 5 of the 5 targets  [20.0/min, 50% of the time, 74.5 HPS]
  2. Geringes Heilen (Rang 3): the default heal, with pauses in between  [5.9/min, 25% of the time, 31.7 HPS]

Heals that reach several targets at once (Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova) are not in the model yet; the group level uses heals on one target at a time.

The casts are spread evenly: after each one the five-second rule holds the spirit regeneration back, the rest of the pause regenerates in full.

=== Damage ===
Every fight is played cast by cast with each rotation you could cast; this is the best one.
With consumables: Geringes Arkanelixier, Salziger Meeresfrüchteeintopf, Schwaches Zauberöl, Trank des Zauberschlags, Rolle der Intelligenz II, Elixier der geringen Intelligenz, Elixier der geringen Willenskraft (+16.2 DPS).

Quick kill: 77.6 DPS  (An enemy that dies in 15 seconds.)
  The mana lasts for the whole fight. At the end 75% mana and 100% health are left.
  1. Schattenwort: Schmerz (Rang 3): keep it on the enemy  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 12.8 DPS]
  2. Verschlingende Seuche (Rang 1): keep it on the enemy  [4.0/min, 10% of the time, 6.9 DPS]
  3. Gedankenschlag (Rang 3): whenever it is ready  [8.0/min, 20% of the time, 20.0 DPS]
  4. Göttliche Pein (Rang 4): fills the rest of the time  [16.0/min, 60% of the time, 37.9 DPS]
  Left out: Heiliges Feuer (Rang 2) (7.7 DPS less; costs more casting time than it returns in this fight)
  Start (mana/health in % before each action): 0 s Schattenwort: Schmerz (Rang 3) [100/100] > 2 s Verschlingende Seuche (Rang 1) [97/100] > 3 s Gedankenschlag (Rang 3) [88/100] > 4 s Göttliche Pein (Rang 4) x3 [85/100] > 12 s Gedankenschlag (Rang 3) [79/100] > 14 s Göttliche Pein (Rang 4) [75/100]
